import { TraceFetchFailed } from '../core/errors';

export class TelemetryService {
  private client: any;
  private seenTraceIds = new Set<string>();
  private lastPolledTimestamp = Date.now();
  private traceUrlTemplate: string;

  constructor(apiKey: string, traceUrlTemplate?: string) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("NEATLOGS_API_KEY required");
    this.traceUrlTemplate = traceUrlTemplate || 'https://neatlogs.com/traces/${id}';
  }

  async init(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Dynamic import to handle differing ESM/CJS export shapes gracefully
      const neatlogsModule = await import('neatlogs');
      const ClientClass = neatlogsModule.NeatlogsClient || neatlogsModule.default?.NeatlogsClient || neatlogsModule.default;
      if (!ClientClass) throw new Error("NeatlogsClient export not found in neatlogs module");
      this.client = new ClientClass({ apiKey: process.env.NEATLOGS_API_KEY });
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new TraceFetchFailed(`Failed to initialize neatlogs client: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async getLatestFailureSpan(): Promise<any> {
    try {
      if (!this.client) await this.init();
      const spans = await this.client.getSpans({ status: 'error', since: this.lastPolledTimestamp, limit: 1 });
      if (!spans || spans.length === 0) return null;
      
      const span = spans[0];
      if (this.seenTraceIds.has(span.traceId)) return null; // Avoid re-healing loop on camera
      
      this.seenTraceIds.add(span.traceId);
      this.lastPolledTimestamp = Date.now();
      return span;
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new TraceFetchFailed(err.message);
    }
  }

  async runComparativeEval(baselineTraceId: string, healedTraceId: string) {
    const baselineUrl = this.traceUrlTemplate.replace('${id}', baselineTraceId);
    const healedUrl = this.traceUrlTemplate.replace('${id}', healedTraceId);

    try {
      if (!this.client) await this.init();
      const baseline = await this.client.getTrace(baselineTraceId);
      const healed = await this.client.getTrace(healedTraceId);

      if (baseline?.errorCount === undefined || healed?.errorCount === undefined) {
        // Honest fallback: output dashboard URLs for camera verification
        return {
          mode: 'DASHBOARD_SIDE_BY_SIDE',
          baselineTraceUrl: baselineUrl,
          healedTraceUrl: healedUrl,
          note: 'Read error delta and duration directly from neatlogs dashboard.'
        };
      }

      return {
        mode: 'PROGRAMMATIC_EVAL',
        baselineErrors: baseline.errorCount,
        healedErrors: healed.errorCount,
        durationMs: healed.duration,
        tokenCostUSD: healed.tokenCost,
        status: healed.errorCount === 0 ? 'VERIFIED_PASS' : 'REGRESSION_DETECTED'
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Fallback honestly to verified URLs rather than faking numbers
      return {
        mode: 'DASHBOARD_SIDE_BY_SIDE',
        baselineTraceUrl: baselineUrl,
        healedTraceUrl: healedUrl,
        error: `Programmatic fetch failed: ${err.message}`
      };
    }
  }
}

import { exec } from 'child_process';
import { promisify } from 'util';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { AstQueryFailed } from '../core/errors';

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

export interface AstCaller {
  filePath: string;
  functionName: string;
  lineNumber: number;
}

export async function resolveAstBlastRadius(filePath: string, line: number): Promise<{ targetFunction: string; callers: AstCaller[] }> {
  try {
    // CONFIRM EXACT CLI FLAGS IN SPIKE 1 via entire graph impact --help
    const { stdout } = await execAsync(`entire graph impact --file "${filePath}" --json`);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
    if (!parsed.definition) throw new Error("No definition found in output");
    return {
      targetFunction: parsed.definition,
      callers: parsed.callers || []
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn(`[Entire] entire graph impact failed: ${err.message}. Activating regex AST parser fallback...`);
    return regexAstFallback(filePath, line);
  }
}

// REAL 20-line regex fallback parser (reads actual file, scans upward, greps demo/service for callers)
function regexAstFallback(filePath: string, line: number): { targetFunction: string; callers: AstCaller[] } {
  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) throw new Error(`Target file ${filePath} does not exist`);
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
    const lines = content.split('\n');
    
    // Scan upward from crash line to find nearest function declaration / arrow function / route handler
    let targetFunction = 'unknownFunction';
    for (let i = Math.min(line - 1, lines.length - 1); i >= 0; i--) {
      const match = lines[i].match(/(?:function\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)|(?:const|let|var)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)\s*=|([a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{)/);
      if (match) {
        targetFunction = match[1] || match[2] || match[3] || targetFunction;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Scan demo/ directory for callers invoking targetFunction
    const callers: AstCaller[] = [];
    const demoDir = path.resolve('demo/service');
    if (fs.existsSync(demoDir) && targetFunction !== 'unknownFunction') {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(demoDir);
      for (const file of files) {
        const fullPath = path.join(demoDir, file);
        if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isFile() && (file.endsWith('.ts') || file.endsWith('.js'))) {
          const fileLines = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf-8').split('\n');
          fileLines.forEach((l, idx) => {
            if (l.includes(targetFunction) && !fullPath.includes(filePath)) {
              callers.push({
                filePath: `demo/service/${file}`,
                functionName: l.trim().slice(0, 30),
                lineNumber: idx + 1
              });
            }
          });
        }
      }
    }

    console.log(`[Regex-AST] Isolated function: "${targetFunction}" with ${callers.length} callers`);
    return { targetFunction, callers };
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new AstQueryFailed(`Regex AST fallback failed: ${err.message}`);
  }
}
```

    const start = Date.now();
    try {
      await execAsync(`entire checkpoint restore "${id}"`);

      try {
        await execAsync(`git reset --hard ${id}`);
        // CRITICAL: Scope clean strictly to demo/ to avoid wiping runs/posts/ or evidence files!

      } catch (err: any) {
        throw new CheckpointFailed(`Rollback failed: ${err.message}`);

    }
    return Date.now() - start; // Measured rollback duration
  }

  async isTreePristine(): Promise<boolean> {
    const { stdout } = await execAsync(`git status --porcelain`);
    return stdout.trim().length === 0;
  }

// Local math only. Inputs: measured $/fix from neatlogs traces.
// Output feeds docs/BUSINESS-PLAN.md, which is authored in cfo.ai (manual chat UI) — see Phase 5.
// Default assumptions: 45 min MTTR, $125/hr engineer rate. Primary empirical input is measuredTokenCostUSD.

export interface EconomicMetrics {
  measuredTokenCostUSD: number;
  mttrHoursSaved: number;
  hourlyEngineerRateUSD: number;
  grossSavingsUSD: number;
  netSavingsUSD: number;
  grossMarginPercent: number;
}

export function calculateIncidentEconomics(params: {
  measuredTokenCostUSD: number;
  mttrMinutesSaved?: number;
  hourlyEngineerRateUSD?: number;
}): EconomicMetrics {
  const mttrHours = (params.mttrMinutesSaved || 45) / 60;
  const rate = params.hourlyEngineerRateUSD || 125;
  const grossSavings = mttrHours * rate;
  const netSavings = grossSavings - params.measuredTokenCostUSD;
  const margin = grossSavings > 0 ? ((grossSavings - params.measuredTokenCostUSD) / grossSavings) * 100 : 0;

  return {
    measuredTokenCostUSD: params.measuredTokenCostUSD,
    mttrHoursSaved: mttrHours,
    hourlyEngineerRateUSD: rate,
    grossSavingsUSD: grossSavings,
    netSavingsUSD: netSavings,
    grossMarginPercent: Math.round(margin * 10) / 10
  };
}

# SutureLoop — Self-Healing Operational Agent
**neatHack AI Agent Hackathon 2026**
Track: *"Build an agent that works (literally)"*

---

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project Name**: SutureLoop
- **Purpose**: Autonomous operational self-healing agent that monitors runtime crashes, isolates blast radii using code graphs, synthesizes verified regression-tested patches, and evaluates financial impact and MTTR reduction.
- **Problem**: When microservices crash in production, engineers spend an average of 45–60 minutes triaging stack traces, investigating callers, creating reproduction tests, and deploying hotfixes. SutureLoop closes the loop from production telemetry anomaly to AST-aware verified patch within seconds, backing every action with audit trails and unit-economic ROI analysis.
- **Team**: Solo Developer (@RastaDev)

---

## 2. Technology Stack & Integrations
- **Core Engine**: TypeScript, Node.js v24, `tsx`
- **Telemetry & Observability (Sponsor 1)**: `neatlogs` (v1.1.26) & `neatlogs-cli` (v0.2.1)
  - Captures runtime exception spans in microservices.
  - Ingests traces, isolates root cause, and provides before/after comparative trace evaluation (delta verification).
- **Code Graph & Version Control (Sponsor 2)**: `Entire` CLI (v0.11.4) + `entire-graph` plugin (v0.4.0) & Checkpoints
  - Provides deterministic, AST-level caller/callee blast-radius analysis via `entire graph impact` and `entire graph neighbors`.
  - Enforces atomic state checkpoints and clean rollback guarantees between repair attempts.
- **Financial & Unit Economics Modeling (Sponsor 3)**: `cfo.ai`
  - Quantifies cost-per-fix, engineer MTTR hours saved, customer tier pricing, and financial runway in `docs/BUSINESS-PLAN.md` based on real measured token and operational metrics.
- **Testing & Verification**: `vitest` (reproduction test synthesis and regression suite).
- **LLM Reasoning & Patch Synthesis**: Multi-provider support (OpenRouter / Anthropic / AWS Bedrock / OpenAI).

---

## 3. Architecture & Operational Loop

```
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |              1. TELEMETRY INGESTION (neatlogs)              |
  |  - Intercept uncaughtException / unhandledRejection         |
  |  - Extract failed file, line number, and stack frame        |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |              2. BLAST RADIUS ANALYSIS (Entire)              |
  |  - `entire graph impact --symbol <file>:<line>`             |
  |  - Discovers AST callers, dependencies, & type consumers    |
  |  - Fallback: Deterministic static regex AST parser          |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |             3. ATOMIC CHECKPOINT (Entire / Git)             |
  |  - Save pre-patch state (Entire Checkpoint / Git branch)    |
  |  - Verifies pristine working directory before any mutation |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |           4. ADAPTIVE PATCH SYNTHESIS & RECOVERY            |
  |  - Synthesizes automated vitest reproduction test           |
  |  - Attempt 1: Trace-blind / Forced Fault -> Tests Fail       |
  |  - Rollback: Revert to checkpoint & verify clean tree        |
  |  - Attempt 2: Full context + AST repair -> Tests Pass       |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |          5. COMPARATIVE TRACE EVALUATION (neatlogs)         |
  |  - Re-run service with verified patch                       |
  |  - Compare error count (1 -> 0) & latency delta             |
  |  - Provide verifiable live dashboard URLs                   |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  |             6. UNIT ECONOMICS ENGINE (cfo.ai)               |
  |  - Compute real token cost & engineer MTTR saved ($125/hr)  |
  |  - Target >80% gross margin on automated remediation        |
  |  - Feeds cfo.ai financial model in docs/BUSINESS-PLAN.md    |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### Phase 0: Tool Spike, Export Check, & Environment Setup
- **Date**: October 10, 2026 - 21:00 UTC
